submission.natural_language_explanation: This pole fires retrospectively on a single-character token, a lone letter or digit with or without a leading space, that is not itself a common standalone word such as a or I: typically the opening fragment of a longer word, such as the first letter of a proper name (Lily, Tandy, Sue), of a vivid descriptive word (yummy, yucky, elderly), or of a compound (x-ray), or a short numeral (3). It does not fire on ordinary multi-letter word tokens, or on single letters that form a complete common word.
